description: Seeded 10-bug ground truth (the S5.2 M4 rubric: 'draft finds >= 80% of a seeded 10-bug fixture'). The subagent reviews diff.patch and cites bug ids; the scorer takes the set-intersection against these ids (>= 8 -> pass).

bugs.desc: off-by-one: range stops at len(items)-1, drops the last item
int division where float is required (// instead of /)
mutates the input list (append) instead of a copy
swapped lo/hi in the clamp guard (lo > hi accepted)
off-by-one slice drops the last character
compares with == instead of == after stripping whitespace
returns None instead of the default on empty input
leaked file handle: open() without with/close
shadowed loop variable: outer name reused in inner comprehension
unhandled IndexError: list indexed at len without bounds check
